
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)


```

we use 10% of the data (train data set) to find the best fitting parameters 

```{r}
train_d <- read_csv(here("adults/behavioral_data/fake_train_d.csv"))

summarised_train_d <- train_d %>% 
 group_by(block_id, fam_trial, block_type) %>% 
 summarise(mean_lt = mean(rt)) %>% 
 mutate(test_type = case_when(
   block_type == "all_background" ~ "fam",
   TRUE ~ "novel"
 ) ) %>% 
rename(fam_duration = fam_trial) %>% 
select(block_id, fam_duration, test_type, mean_lt)
```

# Search for parameters

```{r}
kl_df <- read_csv(here("sim_res/01_param_search_summarized/kl.csv"))
```

## KL

```{r}


all_sim_d <- summarised_train_d %>% 
  left_join(kl_df %>% filter(!is.na(fam_duration == 7)),# we did not sample 7 here
            by = c("fam_duration", "test_type")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(param_info) %>% 
  nest(data = -param_info) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(param_info))

fitting_test_res <- get_fitting_stats(all_sim_d)
```
